Cultural evolution

Research and teaching resources from Joseph Watts, who leads the Cultural Dynamics Lab at the University of Canterbury.

Projects

  • LexiCog — A database of words for thoughts, feelings and other mental states across six languages.
  • Places of Worship Atlas — A map of past and present places of worship in Aotearoa New Zealand.
  • WorldView — A teaching tool for comparing responses across countries in the World Values Survey.
